name: Guofeng Paper
tagline: remotion-guofeng's Chinese-ink paper cut-out: cream paper, vermilion seal as the one saturated colour, springs and a red tear.

motion.direction: Guofeng paper cut-out. Warm paper layers with torn edges and a hard paper shadow; all strokes in ink `#241a14`, never black; vermilion `ter` is the ONE saturated colour, small area — the seal `stamp` on hits, heavy characters, the ending flood; ochre `gold` and dust `goldd` for the rest. Layers enter staggered on a spring (damping 18, stiffness 150; primary 1.4 s from scale 0.84, secondary 1.2 s, tertiary 1.0 s), idle breathing, camera 1.02 → 1.045 glide; transitions are a vermilion torn-paper sweep (`wipe`). One shot ≈ 4 s; captions cream with a dark stroke at the bottom; a `chapterCard` as a torn tag top-left. No photos, no 3D, no neon, no gradients.
